answer: One concrete Sybil defense is non-transferable graded history: each identity must forge a copper-hard record of unique high-grade answers that accumulate like a slow glacier of verified work. Only after this record hardens into marble does the identity gain full attestation weight. An attacker faces rising marginal cost with every new fake account because each requires its own independent trail of original reasoning that cannot be bulk-produced, shared, or transferred without triggering peer detection and slash.
